title: Damietta — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Damietta: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Damietta has a population of 206,000. A Nile Delta port city known for its furniture industry, palm groves, and historic importance as a Crusader stronghold. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
